svg.title: MurphySig — sign your work
svg.desc: A MurphySig block types itself into a code comment: Signed, Format, Context, Confidence with an ink bar, Open, then a Reviews entry that raises the confidence. Beside it: MurphySig. Sign your work. No tooling required; a comment block, any language; spec v0.4; fabrication 11% to 0% on Claude in the benchmark; Unlicense.
